How well does the stress echo identify who will have an event?

First, we define the variable we are trying to explain (AnyEvent) and the variables of the stress echo test that may or may now have predictive power, and make a table with them

```{r}
library(dplyr)
new <- subset(stressEcho, select = c(AnyEvent, PositiveStress))
new
```

Define the tests (posSE, abnormal ecg, restwma, chestpain) and the outcome (any_event). Plan a 2×2 table for each. Compute sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive value by hand with count() and summarise(). Tidy into one table and export it.

```{r}

```

Plot: one dot plot comparing the tests on those four measures. Check whether the test adds information beyond history: event rate by posSE within burden groups, or a logistic model with both. Slide 5, half of slide 8, and prepare to explain what predictive value means when the event rate is 16%.
